text:
rohit: Just deployed v3.2.7 to canary (us-west-2). Seeing p95 jump on embed-service: ~+22% vs baseline within 5m. Deploy-bot flagged it.

deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary metrics breach: embed-service p95 +22% (>auto-rollback threshold 15%). Error rate +0.5% absolute. Recommended action: PAUSE rollout and rollback to v3.2.6. To rollback run:
```
rdwctl rollout pause --env canary-usw
rdwctl deploy rollback --env canary-usw --to v3.2.6
```

maria: How long has the spike been? impact on throughput or just latency?

rohit: Started ~4m ago, throughput steady. Some dedicated test-traffic routed through canary is seeing user-facing latency in a small % of requests. Not a widespread error spike though.

ben: I'll stand by to run manual rollback if we prefer. We should pin traffic before the rollback to avoid flapping.

leah: Product: hold on external change windows? We have a limited scheduled maintenance at 22:00 UTC but this is urgent now. CS should be notified.

claire: I'll ping customer-success and add a short note to the incident channel. tagging @cs on impacted customers list.

rohit: Decision: manual rollback now. Auto-rollback threshold tripped but want human confirmation since dedicated routing touched. ben, please execute the two commands from deploy-bot. rohit: I'm pinning canary to v3.2.6 and opening INF-2345 for follow-up.

ben: Running now.

ops-bot: EXECUTE: rdwctl rollout pause --env canary-usw
ops-bot: EXECUTE: rdwctl deploy rollback --env canary-usw --to v3.2.6

deploy-bot: Rollback started. Monitoring metrics. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: canary back on v3.2.6. p95 returning to baseline within 1m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. Please add a short blurb to the release notes about the rollback and the why (latency regression in embed-service). Also schedule a postmortem (INF-2345) focusing on perf regression tests and canary thresholds.

leah: Filed INF-2345 and assigned to eng-ml + runtime. I'll draft customer-facing language and coordinate with CS.

rohit: Good. After postmortem we can decide if v3.2.7 goes back through extended canary with additional perf tests. Closing thread for now. :eyes:
